title: Control Execution Graph
description: SECB-WP-FWK-082, issue #147. Replaces filename-pattern discovery of controls with the paths CI actually invokes. STATIC_EXECUTION_GRAPH <-> RUNTIME_EXECUTION_RECEIPT <-> CONTROL_SURFACE_REGISTRY are three separate views: this schema describes the FIRST, and a static graph cannot observe the second. Each control path carries six independent statuses and none of them implies the next.

level.description: Enforcement scripts import the standard library only (NFR-12), so no YAML library is available. The parser recognises a declared subset of workflow syntax; anything outside it becomes an UNRESOLVED_DYNAMIC_EDGE rather than silence.

recognised.description: jobs, steps, run, uses, if, needs, strategy.matrix, continue-on-error

DISCOVERED.description: The path appears in the graph. Statically decidable.

REACHABLE.description: CONDITIONAL when a job or step `if` guards it, or when `needs` can skip it. A conditionally-skipped job can report Success and not block a merge even as a required check, so conditional reachability is NOT execution.

EXECUTED.description: Requires a run. A static graph cannot observe execution, and this field exists to stop DISCOVERED from being read as EXECUTED.

RESULT_PROPAGATED.description: false is statically PROVEN when continue-on-error is true: the step cannot fail its job, so its result reaches no consumer. Otherwise a run is required.

NORMATIVELY_CONSUMED.description: Whether a consumer read the result. Belongs to the runtime-receipt view; the vocabulary is secb.pr-input-binding/v1's, not restated here.

ENFORCED.description: Requires observing branch protection or a ruleset. Not observed by a static parser.

unresolved_edges.description: Edges the parser could not follow. An unresolved edge is reported, never dropped: a silent omission is indistinguishable from an absent control.
